A.title: What Will Shopping Centres Become? (Original reading)
A.text:
A - For many years, shopping centres offered people a convenient place to purchase clothes, food and household items. Recently, online retailers have become serious competitors. Customers can compare prices without leaving home, and some older centres have lost visitors. However, shopping centres are not necessarily going to disappear. Owners are considering new reasons for people to spend time there.

B - In the past, most centres were designed around large stores. Now several managers are adding leisure activities. One centre in Northbridge has opened a small indoor climbing wall beside its cinema. Another is planning a cooking school. These facilities attract people who may not want to shop but are happy to meet friends. Some businesses expect the new services to increase the number of visitors.

C - Other centres are trying to become useful neighbourhood spaces. In the town of Larchfield, a former clothing store has become a free study room. Local groups run language exchanges there on Saturdays. A health clinic is going to open nearby next spring. The aim is not simply to sell products but to offer services that residents need regularly.

D - Temporary shops are also growing in popularity. Rather than signing a long contract, small businesses can rent a space for just a few weeks. A local bookshop, for instance, opened a short-term stall during the school holidays. It sold books and organised storytelling sessions. The manager explained that a temporary location helped the business test demand before making a larger investment.

E - Environmental changes are another priority. Some developers plan to install solar panels and larger windows to reduce electricity use. A new centre in Willow Park is going to collect rainwater for its plants. Designers believe customers will also appreciate more trees, open-air seating and natural light. These decisions may make centres more comfortable as well as less expensive to operate.

F - Technology will probably play a greater role, too. Visitors may use digital maps to locate shops and receive information about events. A few centres are testing virtual fitting rooms so that shoppers can see how clothes might look. Yet not everyone wants a fully digital experience. The most successful centres will probably combine convenient technology with places where people can relax and talk face to face.

B.title: Markets That Tell a Local Story (Original exam reading)
B.text:
A - Many travellers expect every city to have familiar supermarkets and chain stores. Traditional markets offer a different experience: visitors can learn about local food, crafts and customs while speaking directly with sellers. Some markets open daily, while others appear only at certain times of the year.

B - At Greenfield Farmers' Market, growers bring seasonal vegetables from farms outside the city. Customers buy fresh produce without several layers of packaging. Most stalls sell items harvested recently, and the prices can be lower than those in specialist city shops. The busiest morning is Saturday, when families arrive early to choose fruit and bread.

C - The Riverside Clothing Market is popular among people who want unusual clothes. One area sells carefully selected second-hand jackets and dresses. Another offers handmade accessories by young designers. Shoppers can sometimes change an existing piece of clothing instead of buying a completely new one. This helps them create an individual style at a reasonable price.

D - A flea market allows residents to sell things they no longer need. At Old Station Square, tables are filled with used lamps, games, small furniture and old records. Visitors should check an item's condition carefully because sellers do not always accept returns. A family might discover a useful desk, while a collector may search for a rare book.

E - Hilltown Craft Market attracts tourists who want something connected to the region. Local artists sell pottery, woven bags and wooden ornaments. Some craftsmen demonstrate how they make their products. Visitors often prefer these handmade objects to mass-produced souvenirs because each one carries a story about local materials or techniques.

F - During the winter festival, the streets around the town hall become a seasonal market. Colourful lights are placed above the stalls, and visitors can buy small gifts, warm drinks and decorations. The market is open only for four weekends. People often come to enjoy the music and atmosphere rather than to purchase anything expensive.

G - Markets vary widely in size and purpose, but they share one advantage: they give buyers opportunities to discover products and meet the people behind them. A good market is therefore more than a collection of stalls. It can help a community preserve local skills and support small businesses.

A.title: Three shopping locations
dialogue: I usually buy vegetables at the outdoor market near my flat. The sellers know me, and the fruit is fresh.
My favourite place is the shopping centre near the station. It has a cinema and a café under one roof.
When I need milk or rice, I go to the supermarket. It is open until ten in the evening.

B.title: Finding the new sports shop
dialogue: The new sports shop was going to open on the north side of town, near the stadium. However, the owners changed their plans. It will actually open in the west, next to the library. The opening is on Saturday.

C.title: Shopping-centre opening hours
dialogue: The centre opens at nine on weekdays. On Sundays it used to open at ten, but that has changed: the doors now open at eleven. Please note that most restaurants remain open until nine in the evening.

D.title: T-shirt choices and arrival time
dialogue: Are you looking for a plain T-shirt or one with a picture?
I thought about a shirt with writing on it, but I do not like the words. I will take the one with a photograph.
Good choice. Your friend is coming later?
Yes, she first said half past two. Actually she will arrive at a quarter to three, not a quarter past two.

E.title: A shopping tour – Section 2 practice
dialogue: Welcome to the Old Town shopping tour. We are meeting outside the train station, not the theatre across the road. Please keep your ticket with you.
Our first stop is the Heritage Theatre. People come here mainly for music performances, although the building is very old.
We planned to start at nine fifteen, but the bus was delayed. It is now nine thirty, so we will begin immediately.
At Market Square, you can buy handmade souvenirs. There is a fruit market nearby, but we are not visiting it today.
We will then enter the Regional Food Centre to taste locally produced cheese. You can buy juice in the shop afterwards, but tasting is the reason for our visit.
Finally, the Fashion Fair is in the building with the green roof. The red building next to it is the café. Our tour ends at twelve fifteen.

F.title: Speaking Part 1: shopping habits
dialogue: Where do you usually go shopping?
I usually shop at a small market near my home because prices are reasonable and the sellers are friendly.
Do you prefer shopping online or in person?
For books I prefer shopping online, as it saves time. However, I try on shoes in person because I want to check the size.
Only when I buy something useful. I try to plan my purchases so I do not waste money.

G.title: Speaking Part 2: a favourite shop
dialogue: I would like to describe a small stationery shop close to my university. It is on a quiet street near the bus stop, so I can reach it easily.
The shop sells notebooks, pens, art materials and useful gifts. I usually visit it once or twice a month when I need something for my classes.

What I really like is the friendly atmosphere. The owner remembers regular customers and gives practical advice. The prices are fair, and the products are often more original than those in larger stores.
Last month I bought a sketchbook for a friend, and she was delighted. That experience reminded me why I enjoy supporting small local shops.

items.explanation_vi: Tiết kiệm thời gian là lợi ích.

items.question_en: Some websites are difficult to trust.
items.question_vi: Một số trang khó đáng tin.
items.explanation_en: Low trust is a risk, so a drawback.
items.explanation_vi: Rủi ro thiếu tin cậy là nhược điểm.

items.question_en: I believe local markets should be protected.
items.question_vi: Tôi nghĩ nên bảo vệ chợ truyền thống.
items.explanation_en: I believe announces personal judgement.
items.explanation_vi: I believe là dấu hiệu ý kiến.

items.question_en: Customers can compare prices quickly.
items.question_vi: Khách so giá nhanh.
items.explanation_en: The ability to compare is convenient.
items.explanation_vi: So sánh nhanh là điểm tích cực.

activities.title: Recognise Task 2 question types
activities.instruction_en: Identify agree/disagree, outweigh or discuss-both-views.
activities.instruction_vi: Nhận dạng 3 kiểu câu hỏi Task 2.

items.question_en: “To what extent do you agree or disagree?” ->
items.question_vi: Dạng câu To what extent...?
items.explanation_en: You must defend a clear degree of agreement.
items.explanation_vi: Cần nêu mức độ đồng ý rõ ràng.

items.question_en: “Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” ->
items.question_vi: Ưu điểm vượt nhược điểm?
items.explanation_en: Weigh benefits against drawbacks and make a judgement.
items.explanation_vi: So sánh hai mặt rồi kết luận bên nào hơn.

items.question_en: “Discuss both views and give your opinion.” ->
items.question_vi: Trình bày hai quan điểm và ý kiến.
items.explanation_en: Both viewpoints and your position are required.
items.explanation_vi: Phải nêu cả hai quan điểm và quan điểm của bạn.

activities.title: Choose a consistent position
activities.instruction_en: Write an opinion you can defend with reasons.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn quan điểm nhất quán và có lý do.

items.question_en: Topic: large supermarkets harm local shops. Write a balanced but clear position.
items.question_vi: Chủ đề: siêu thị lớn gây hại cửa hàng nhỏ. Nêu quan điểm.
items.answer: I partly agree because large chains create competition, but local shops can succeed by offering personalised service.
items.explanation_en: This gives a degree of agreement plus two defensible reasons.
items.explanation_vi: Câu nêu đồng ý một phần và 2 lý do có thể triển khai; không đứng giữa mơ hồ.

items.question_en: Which is a clearer thesis? A. There are good and bad things. B. I partly agree that supermarkets threaten small shops, but local service can help them survive.
items.question_vi: Chọn thesis rõ ràng hơn.
items.explanation_en: B states a position and previews reasoning.
items.explanation_vi: B nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý và hướng lập luận.

activities.title: Brainstorm benefits and drawbacks
activities.instruction_en: For each idea, decide whether it is an advantage or drawback.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân loại và phát triển ý.

items.question_en: Lower prices from strong competition are mainly a(n) ...
items.question_vi: Cạnh tranh làm giá thấp là ...
items.explanation_en: Lower costs help customers, although other issues may exist.
items.explanation_vi: Giá thấp mang lợi ích cho khách hàng.

items.question_en: Long queues during peak hours are a(n) ...
items.question_vi: Xếp hàng dài vào giờ cao điểm là ...
items.explanation_en: Queues waste time.
items.explanation_vi: Xếp hàng lâu tốn thời gian.

items.question_en: Give a specific drawback of buying shoes online.
items.question_vi: Nêu bất lợi cụ thể mua giày online.
items.answer: The size may not fit, so I might need to return the shoes.
items.explanation_en: A concrete example is more persuasive than “online shopping is bad”.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ sai cỡ và trả hàng cụ thể hơn nhận xét chung chung.

items.question_en: Give a specific benefit of a local shop.
items.question_vi: Nêu lợi ích cửa hàng địa phương.
items.answer: A local owner may remember my preferences and suggest suitable products.
items.explanation_en: Personal service differentiates small shops.
items.explanation_vi: Dịch vụ cá nhân hóa là điểm khác biệt rõ.

activities.title: Introduction: background and position
activities.instruction_en: Choose the stronger introduction.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn mở bài tốt hơn.

items.question_en: Which opening is better? A. I love shopping. B. Online buying has become common, but I believe physical shops still matter.
items.question_vi: Mở bài nào hợp văn học thuật hơn?
items.explanation_en: It paraphrases the topic and includes a position without a personal anecdote.
items.explanation_vi: B dẫn chủ đề và nêu quan điểm, không kể chuyện lan man.

items.question_en: Should an introduction contain several long examples?
items.question_vi: Mở bài có nên đưa nhiều ví dụ dài?
items.explanation_en: Examples belong mainly in body paragraphs.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ cụ thể nên đặt thân bài.

items.question_en: Write one opening sentence about cashless payments.
items.question_vi: Viết câu mở về thanh toán không tiền mặt.
items.answer: Cashless payments have become increasingly common in everyday shopping.
items.explanation_en: A neutral background sentence introduces the issue.
items.explanation_vi: Câu nền trung tính giới thiệu vấn đề.

activities.title: Edit a weak introduction
activities.instruction_en: Identify repetition and unsupported claims.
activities.instruction_vi: Tìm lặp ý và khẳng định thiếu căn cứ.

items.question_en: Weak: “Shopping online is shopping on the internet.” What is the main issue?
items.question_vi: Vấn đề ở câu lặp định nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: The sentence repeats the same meaning and develops no context.
items.explanation_vi: Câu diễn đạt lặp ý, chưa phát triển bối cảnh.

items.question_en: Weak: “Everyone hates supermarkets.” Why avoid this?
items.question_vi: Vì sao tránh Everyone hates...?
items.explanation_en: Everyone is an unsupported absolute claim.
items.explanation_vi: Everyone tuyệt đối hóa không có bằng chứng.

items.question_en: Improve: “Shopping online has good things and bad things.”
items.question_vi: Sửa câu diễn đạt chung chung.
items.answer: Buying goods online offers convenience, although delivery problems can reduce customer satisfaction.
items.explanation_en: Specific benefits and drawbacks make a clearer frame.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu lợi ích và hạn chế cụ thể tạo nền tốt hơn.

activities.title: Paraphrase without changing meaning
activities.instruction_en: Rewrite a statement with different words.
activities.instruction_vi: Diễn đạt lại mà giữ nghĩa.

items.question_en: Paraphrase “Many customers prefer online shopping.”
items.question_vi: Viết lại câu nhiều khách thích mua online.
items.answer: A large number of consumers favour purchasing products on the internet.
items.explanation_en: Many -> a large number of; customers -> consumers; prefer -> favour.
items.explanation_vi: Thay cụm đồng nghĩa nhưng vẫn giữ chủ thể và ý thích.

items.question_en: Paraphrase “Small shops may struggle to compete.”
items.question_vi: Viết lại câu cửa hàng nhỏ khó cạnh tranh.
items.answer: Independent retailers can find it difficult to compete.
items.explanation_en: May struggle is rephrased as can find it difficult.
items.explanation_vi: May struggle được diễn đạt thành can find it difficult.

items.question_en: Does “all shops will close” paraphrase “some shops may close”?
items.question_vi: All shops will close có đồng nghĩa some shops may close?
items.explanation_en: All vs some and will vs may change strength and meaning.
items.explanation_vi: All khác some, will khác may: diễn đạt lại sai mức độ.

activities.title: Write a three-sentence introduction
activities.instruction_en: Introduction for an outweigh question about cashless society.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết mở bài 3 câu cho cashless society.

items.question_en: Sentence 1: neutral background.
items.question_vi: Câu 1: nêu bối cảnh.
items.answer: Many people now pay for everyday purchases with cards or mobile applications.
items.explanation_en: Give a current, relevant context without invented statistics.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu thực trạng phổ biến, không bịa số liệu.

items.question_en: Sentence 2: introduce two sides.
items.question_vi: Câu 2: nêu hai mặt.
items.answer: This change offers convenience, but it may exclude people without reliable digital access.
items.explanation_en: Mention one real benefit and one possible concern.
items.explanation_vi: Câu cân bằng ích lợi và nỗi lo thực tế.

items.question_en: Sentence 3: clear position.
items.question_vi: Câu 3: nêu quan điểm.
items.answer: I believe the advantages generally outweigh the disadvantages if cash remains an option.
items.explanation_en: The position is clear and appropriately qualified.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu rõ lợi lớn hơn hại với điều kiện cụ thể.

activities.title: Claims and supporting examples
activities.instruction_en: Match each claim with credible support.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối luận điểm với ví dụ hợp lý.

items.question_en: Claim: small shops give personal service. Strongest example? A. The owner suggests suitable materials B. The building is yellow C. It opened yesterday
items.question_vi: Ví dụ nào phù hợp dịch vụ cá nhân?
items.explanation_en: Individual advice directly supports personal service.
items.explanation_vi: Lời khuyên riêng phù hợp luận điểm.

items.question_en: Claim: online shopping is convenient. Strongest example? A. Products have names B. Customers order after work without travelling C. Shops have signs
items.question_vi: Ví dụ nào hỗ trợ tính tiện lợi?
items.explanation_en: Ordering anytime without travel shows convenience.
items.explanation_vi: Đặt sau giờ làm không đi xa là ví dụ rõ.

items.question_en: Add reasoning to: “Some shoppers spend too much online.”
items.question_vi: Giải thích vì sao mua online dễ chi quá tay.
items.answer: Frequent discounts may encourage people to buy items they did not plan to purchase.
items.explanation_en: This gives a mechanism, not just repeats the claim.
items.explanation_vi: Giải thích cơ chế giảm giá kích thích mua sắm bốc đồng.

activities.title: Develop a paragraph with PEEL
activities.instruction_en: Use Point–Explain–Example–Link.
activities.instruction_vi: Phát triển đoạn theo Point–Explain–Example–Link.

items.question_en: Point: write a topic sentence on the benefit of online shopping.
items.question_vi: Point: câu chủ đề lợi ích mua online.
items.answer: One major benefit of online shopping is the time it saves.
items.explanation_en: The topic sentence clearly names the paragraph focus.
items.explanation_vi: Câu chủ đề chỉ rõ lợi ích tiết kiệm thời gian.

items.question_en: Explain: why does this benefit happen?
items.question_vi: Explain: vì sao tiết kiệm thời gian?
items.answer: Customers can compare and order products from home instead of travelling between stores.
items.explanation_en: The explanation connects the claim to a real mechanism.
items.explanation_vi: Giải thích vì sao mua ở nhà nhanh hơn tới nhiều cửa hàng.

items.question_en: Example: provide a realistic illustration.
items.question_vi: Example: cho ví dụ cụ thể.
items.answer: For example, a busy parent can buy school supplies online after work.
items.explanation_en: The example illustrates convenience without inventing study data.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ người bận mua đồ học sau giờ làm, không bịa thống kê.

items.question_en: Link: connect to the discussion.
items.question_vi: Link: liên hệ luận điểm chung.
items.answer: Therefore, online stores can be especially useful to people with limited free time.
items.explanation_en: The final line restates the point without merely copying the topic sentence.
items.explanation_vi: Câu chốt kết nối về lợi ích đối với người ít thời gian.

activities.title: Study an original essay
activities.instruction_en: Analyse the independent sample essay in the teacher guide.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân tích bài mẫu tự biên soạn.

items.question_en: How many positions should an agree/disagree essay maintain?
items.question_vi: Bài agree/disagree nên giữ bao nhiêu lập trường xuyên suốt?
items.explanation_en: A clear stance may be qualified, but should not contradict itself.
items.explanation_vi: Quan điểm có thể điều kiện hóa nhưng không được tự mâu thuẫn.

items.question_en: Does a personal example alone prove a claim about all consumers?
items.question_vi: Ví dụ cá nhân có chứng minh tất cả khách hàng?
items.explanation_en: An example illustrates; it does not establish a universal fact.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ minh họa ý, không chứng minh tính phổ quát.

items.question_en: Identify two benefits of local shops to develop in an essay.
items.question_vi: Nêu 2 lợi ích cửa hàng nhỏ để viết.
items.answer: personalised advice; support for local jobs
items.explanation_en: These are distinct arguments that can be explained and illustrated.
items.explanation_vi: Hai lập luận khác nhau, có thể giải thích và ví dụ riêng.

activities.title: Organise four essay paragraphs
activities.instruction_en: Arrange introduction, two body paragraphs and conclusion.
activities.instruction_vi: Sắp xếp bốn đoạn.

items.question_en: Which paragraph should state the overall position first?
items.question_vi: Đoạn nào nên nêu quan điểm?
items.explanation_en: Task response benefits from an early clear position.
items.explanation_vi: Quan điểm xuất hiện từ mở bài giúp trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

items.question_en: Which section should contain evidence and examples?
items.question_vi: Phần nào đưa lý do, ví dụ?
items.explanation_en: Body paragraphs develop the main arguments.
items.explanation_vi: Thân bài giải thích ý chính và ví dụ.

items.question_en: Should the conclusion introduce an unrelated new argument?
items.question_vi: Kết luận có nên đưa luận điểm mới?
items.explanation_en: The conclusion consolidates the judgement.
items.explanation_vi: Kết luận chỉ khái quát lại quan điểm.

activities.title: Cohesion and future forms
activities.instruction_en: Select natural linking language and correct future grammar.
activities.instruction_vi: Luyện từ nối và thì tương lai.

items.question_en: “Online shops are convenient. ___, there are concerns about returns.” (However / Therefore)
items.question_vi: Điền từ nối đối lập.
items.explanation_en: The second sentence contrasts with the positive point.
items.explanation_vi: Câu sau nêu bất lợi đối lập câu trước.

items.question_en: “The owners have signed a contract. They ___ open in July.” (will / are going to)
items.question_vi: Có hợp đồng rồi, sẽ khai trương.
items.explanation_en: A prior arrangement supports going to.
items.explanation_vi: Đã có kế hoạch/hợp đồng nên going to.

items.question_en: “I believe small stores ___ continue to serve loyal customers.” (will / are going to)
items.question_vi: Dự đoán theo I believe.
items.explanation_en: This is a future prediction of belief.
items.explanation_vi: I believe + will cho dự đoán nhận định.

items.question_en: “For example” introduces a(n) ...
items.question_vi: For example giới thiệu điều gì?
items.explanation_en: It marks evidence illustrating a claim.
items.explanation_vi: Cụm này dẫn ví dụ hỗ trợ.

activities.title: Conclusions and final editing
activities.instruction_en: Draft a focused conclusion and check your essay.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết kết luận rõ và tự kiểm bài.

items.question_en: Write one concluding sentence for shopping-centre entertainment.
items.question_vi: Viết câu kết cho đề trung tâm thương mại giải trí.
items.answer: In conclusion, I expect leisure facilities to become more common, but shops will still be essential.
items.explanation_en: This restates a qualified opinion without adding a new argument.
items.explanation_vi: Câu nhắc lại mức độ đồng ý, không chèn luận điểm mới.

items.question_en: Which conclusion is better? A. I want to buy shoes tomorrow. B. Overall, local shops will still be valuable because of personal service.
items.question_vi: Kết bài nào phù hợp?
items.explanation_en: B summarises a reason and a position, whereas A is an unrelated personal plan.
items.explanation_vi: B khái quát ý và lập trường, A lạc đề.

items.question_en: Your essay is 230 words. Is that enough for IELTS Writing Task 2?
items.question_vi: Bài 230 từ có đạt tối thiểu không?
items.explanation_en: Task 2 instructions require at least 250 words.
items.explanation_vi: Writing Task 2 yêu cầu tối thiểu 250 từ.

items.question_en: Name three final checks for an essay.
items.question_vi: Nêu 3 bước kiểm bài luận.
items.answer: Position is consistent; examples support claims; grammar and linking are accurate.
items.explanation_en: These checks target response, development and language control.
items.explanation_vi: Kiểm tính nhất quán, minh chứng và ngữ pháp/từ nối.

activities.title: Timed independent IELTS Task 2
activities.instruction_en: Write at least 250 words in around 40 minutes.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết ít nhất 250 từ trong khoảng 40 phút.

items.question_en: Essay task: In future, shopping centres will mainly be places for leisure rather than buying products. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write a complete essay (250+ words).
items.question_vi: Viết bài Task 2 về trung tâm thương mại tương lai thiên về giải trí hơn mua sắm, 250+ từ.
items.answer: Suggested position: Partly agree. Introduction: malls are changing; position. Body 1: cinemas, cafés and community services attract visitors. Body 2: shops still sell daily goods and provide in-person service. Conclusion: both functions will remain.
items.explanation_en: There is no unique correct essay. Check 250+ words, response to “extent”, paragraph logic, evidence, language and consistency.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án mở: kiểm tối thiểu 250 từ, trả lời mức độ đồng ý, lập luận và ví dụ từng đoạn, ngữ pháp, liên kết, nhất quán; cần giáo viên đánh giá.

activities.title: Lead-in: recognise shopping places
activities.instruction_en: Name the shopping places and match clues.
activities.instruction_vi: Nhận diện địa điểm mua sắm.

items.question_en: Where are products generally arranged in long aisles with shelves?
items.question_vi: Hàng bày theo dãy dài trên kệ ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: A supermarket typically uses aisles for food and daily necessities.
items.explanation_vi: Siêu thị thường xếp hàng thành nhiều dãy kệ.

items.question_en: Where do you bargain with independent stallholders?
items.question_vi: Mặc cả với người bán lẻ ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: Market stalls are typical of an outdoor market.
items.explanation_vi: Chợ ngoài trời có nhiều sạp hàng.

items.question_en: Which place commonly has several shops and a cinema under one roof?
items.question_vi: Nhiều cửa hàng và rạp phim chung một tòa?
items.explanation_en: Multiple retailers and leisure services share the building.
items.explanation_vi: Trung tâm thương mại có nhiều cửa hàng và dịch vụ chung.

activities.title: Match three speakers to places
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track A. Write place names for speakers 1–3.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track A, ghi địa điểm của 3 người nói.

items.question_en: Speaker 1 shops at a(n) ___.
items.question_vi: Người 1 đi đâu mua hàng?
items.explanation_en: The speaker describes fresh vegetables and individual sellers.
items.explanation_vi: Người 1 nói chợ rau quả và người bán quen.

items.question_en: Speaker 2 prefers the ___.
items.question_vi: Người 2 thích đâu?
items.explanation_en: The speaker mentions a cinema and café under one roof.
items.explanation_vi: Người 2 nhắc rạp phim và quán cà phê cùng tòa.

items.question_en: Speaker 3 uses the ___ for food essentials.
items.question_vi: Người 3 mua thực phẩm thiết yếu ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: Milk, rice and opening hours identify a supermarket.
items.explanation_vi: Sữa, gạo và mở cửa đến 10h là siêu thị.

activities.title: Distractors: final shop location
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track B. Notice a changed plan.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe B: phân biệt vị trí ban đầu và cuối.

items.question_en: The sports shop will open in the ___ of town. (north / west / east)
items.question_vi: Cửa hàng mở hướng nào?
items.explanation_en: The north side is rejected; “actually ... west” gives the correction.
items.explanation_vi: Phía bắc bị bỏ; cụm actually ... west mới là thông tin cuối.

items.question_en: Which landmark is next to the final shop? (stadium / library / hospital)
items.question_vi: Mốc nào cạnh cửa hàng mới?
items.explanation_en: The library appears after the changed plan.
items.explanation_vi: Thư viện nằm cạnh địa điểm mới, sân vận động là bẫy.

items.question_en: What day is the opening?
items.question_vi: Khai trương thứ mấy?
items.explanation_en: The announcement explicitly says Saturday.
items.explanation_vi: Cuối thông báo nêu Saturday.

activities.title: Distractors: times and corrections
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track C and distinguish previous/current times.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe C phân biệt giờ trước và hiện tại.

items.question_en: On Sundays, what time does the centre now open?
items.question_vi: Chủ nhật hiện mở lúc mấy giờ?
items.explanation_en: Ten is the previous time; eleven is the new Sunday opening time.
items.explanation_vi: 10h là giờ cũ; 11h là giờ hiện tại.

items.question_en: On weekdays, what time does it open?
items.question_vi: Ngày thường mở mấy giờ?
items.explanation_en: The announcement gives nine on weekdays.
items.explanation_vi: Thông báo nêu 9h vào ngày thường.

items.question_en: Until what time do most restaurants remain open?
items.question_vi: Nhà hàng mở đến mấy giờ?
items.explanation_en: This is the restaurants’ closing time, not the mall opening time.
items.explanation_vi: 9 giờ tối là giờ nhà hàng đóng, khác giờ trung tâm mở.

activities.title: Paraphrase in recordings
activities.instruction_en: Match phrase to synonym.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối từ đồng nghĩa thường gặp trong audio.

items.question_en: “a wide selection” means: A. many choices B. no choices C. very expensive
items.question_vi: Wide selection nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: Both refer to variety.
items.explanation_vi: Cả hai nói nhiều lựa chọn.

items.question_en: “at the weekend” refers to: A. weekdays B. Saturday or Sunday C. next month
items.question_vi: At the weekend là khi nào?
items.explanation_en: Weekend means Saturday and Sunday in standard usage.
items.explanation_vi: Cuối tuần gồm thứ Bảy/Chủ nhật.

items.question_en: “next to” is closest to: A. beside B. opposite C. far from
items.question_vi: Next to gần nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: Both indicate adjacent location.
items.explanation_vi: Cả hai nghĩa là bên cạnh.

items.question_en: “a quarter to three” is: A. 2:15 B. 2:45 C. 3:15
items.question_vi: Quarter to three là giờ nào?
items.explanation_en: A quarter to three is 15 minutes before 3:00.
items.explanation_vi: Quarter to three = 3 giờ kém 15 = 2:45.

activities.title: Multiple choice: T-shirt choices
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track D and select the final option.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe D, chọn thông tin cuối.

items.question_en: Which shirt does the customer buy? A. plain B. with writing C. with a photograph
items.question_vi: Khách mua áo nào?
items.explanation_en: The writing option is rejected; the photograph option is accepted.
items.explanation_vi: Khách không thích áo có chữ, chọn áo có ảnh.

items.question_en: What time will the friend arrive? A. 2:15 B. 2:30 C. 2:45
items.question_vi: Bạn đến lúc mấy giờ?
items.explanation_en: Half past two is the old time; a quarter to three is the corrected one.
items.explanation_vi: 2:30 là giờ cũ, 2:45 là giờ được sửa.

activities.title: Eliminate incorrect multiple choices
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track E and eliminate distractors.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe E và loại lựa chọn sai.

items.question_en: Where does the tour start? A. theatre B. station C. café
items.question_vi: Tour bắt đầu ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: The guide contrasts station with theatre.
items.explanation_vi: Hướng dẫn nói tập trung ở ga, không phải nhà hát.

items.question_en: Why do visitors go to the Heritage Theatre? A. famous actors B. musical performances C. new cinema
items.question_vi: Vì sao tới nhà hát?
items.explanation_en: The building is old, but music is the primary attraction.
items.explanation_vi: Cũ là chi tiết phụ; âm nhạc mới là lý do.

items.question_en: What item can be purchased at Market Square? A. souvenirs B. fruit and vegetables C. tickets
items.question_vi: Mua gì ở quảng trường?
items.explanation_en: The guide says handmade souvenirs; the nearby fruit market is not visited.
items.explanation_vi: Tour chỉ ghé quà thủ công, không ghé chợ trái cây.

activities.title: Exam skills: Section 2 tour
activities.instruction_en: Answer six questions after listening to Track E twice.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track E 2 lần, trả lời 6 câu trắc nghiệm.

items.question_en: 1. The tour meets outside the ... A. train station B. theatre C. cinema
items.question_vi: Nơi tập trung?
items.explanation_en: The opening says meeting outside the train station.
items.explanation_vi: Đầu bài nói train station, theatre ở đối diện.

items.question_en: 2. The theatre is popular for ... A. music B. dance C. food
items.question_vi: Nhà hát nổi tiếng vì gì?
items.explanation_en: Music performances are given as the main reason.
items.explanation_vi: Lý do chính là biểu diễn nhạc.

items.question_en: 3. The tour starts at ... A. 9:15 B. 9:30 C. 9:45
items.question_vi: Bắt đầu lúc?
items.explanation_en: A delayed bus changes the planned 9:15 start.
items.explanation_vi: Bài sửa 9:15 thành 9:30.

items.question_en: 4. At Market Square people buy ... A. fruit B. souvenirs C. clothing
items.question_vi: Mua gì ở chợ?
items.explanation_en: Handmade souvenirs are the direct statement.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nêu handmade souvenirs.

items.question_en: 5. Why visit the Food Centre? A. buy juice B. eat lunch C. taste cheese
items.question_vi: Mục đích đến Food Centre?
items.explanation_en: Buying juice is optional afterwards, not the main purpose.
items.explanation_vi: Nếm phô mai là mục đích; mua nước là tùy chọn.

items.question_en: 6. Which building contains the fair? A. green roof B. red walls C. blue doors
items.question_vi: Hội chợ ở tòa nào?
items.explanation_en: The red building is a nearby café, making it a distractor.
items.explanation_vi: Mái xanh là hội chợ; tòa đỏ là quán cà phê.

activities.title: Listening review and error analysis
activities.instruction_en: Explain one trap and prepare a listening checklist.
activities.instruction_vi: Giải thích bẫy và lập bảng tự kiểm.

items.question_en: “We planned 9:15, but now 9:30.” Which time is correct?
items.question_vi: Giờ dự kiến 9:15 nhưng hiện 9:30, chọn nào?
items.explanation_en: But now signals a correction.
items.explanation_vi: But now đánh dấu giờ sửa và là đáp án.

items.question_en: Are correct answers always repeated exactly as the question wording?
items.question_vi: Audio có luôn lặp y từ câu hỏi?
items.explanation_en: Questions are often paraphrased with synonyms or changed grammar.
items.explanation_vi: Câu hỏi hay diễn đạt lại bằng từ đồng nghĩa hoặc cấu trúc khác.

items.question_en: Write two checks before submitting your listening answers.
items.question_vi: Nêu hai bước tự kiểm trước khi nộp đáp án.
items.answer: Check the final confirmed fact; check spelling/word limit.
items.explanation_en: These two checks prevent distractor and format errors.
items.explanation_vi: Kiểm thông tin cuối và chính tả/giới hạn từ để tránh lỗi phổ biến.

activities.title: Lead-in: shopping preferences
activities.instruction_en: Answer personal questions with one reason.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời câu hỏi cá nhân và thêm lý do.

items.question_en: Where do you usually shop?
items.question_vi: Bạn thường mua sắm ở đâu?
items.answer: I usually shop at a local market because it is close to my home.
items.explanation_en: Direct answer + because makes an extended Part 1 answer.
items.explanation_vi: Trả lời thẳng + because giúp mở rộng Part 1.

items.question_en: How often do you go shopping?
items.question_vi: Bạn đi mua sắm thường xuyên không?
items.answer: About twice a week, mostly to buy groceries.
items.explanation_en: A frequency plus purpose is natural.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu tần suất kèm mục đích giúp tự nhiên.

items.question_en: Do you prefer shopping alone?
items.question_vi: Bạn thích đi mua một mình?
items.answer: For everyday items, yes, because I can finish quickly.
items.explanation_en: An answer may be conditional rather than absolute.
items.explanation_vi: Có thể trả lời có điều kiện, không nhất thiết luôn luôn.

activities.title: Useful vocabulary in model answers
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track F and notice expressions of preference.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe F, tìm cụm chỉ sở thích.

items.question_en: The candidate likes the market because prices are ...
items.question_vi: Lý do giá ở chợ thế nào?
items.explanation_en: Track F says prices are reasonable.
items.explanation_vi: Track F nêu giá reasonable = vừa phải.

items.question_en: For which product does the candidate prefer online shopping?
items.question_vi: Mua gì bạn thích online?
items.explanation_en: The speaker names books as an online purchase.
items.explanation_vi: Người nói chọn sách để mua online.

items.question_en: Why does the candidate buy shoes in person?
items.question_vi: Vì sao mua giày trực tiếp?
items.explanation_en: The speaker wants to try shoes to make sure of the size.
items.explanation_vi: Muốn kiểm cỡ giày cho đúng.

activities.title: Antonyms for describing shops
activities.instruction_en: Pair useful positive and negative adjectives.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghép tính từ trái nghĩa.

items.question_en: convenient ↔ ...
items.question_vi: Trái nghĩa convenient.
items.explanation_en: In- makes the opposite for this adjective.
items.explanation_vi: Tiền tố in- tạo nghĩa không tiện lợi.

items.question_en: affordable ↔ ...
items.question_vi: Trái nghĩa affordable.
items.explanation_en: Affordable describes manageable prices; expensive means costly.
items.explanation_vi: Affordable vừa túi tiền, expensive đắt.

items.question_en: friendly atmosphere ↔ ...
items.question_vi: Trái nghĩa không khí thân thiện.
items.explanation_en: Unwelcoming signals a place that does not feel friendly.
items.explanation_vi: Unwelcoming chỉ cảm giác thiếu thân thiện.

items.question_en: a wide selection ↔ ...
items.question_vi: Trái nghĩa nhiều lựa chọn.
items.explanation_en: Limited choice means few options.
items.explanation_vi: Limited choice chỉ ít lựa chọn.

activities.title: Part 1: develop personal reasons
activities.instruction_en: Give an answer–reason–example response.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời + giải thích + ví dụ.

items.question_en: Why do you prefer some small shops?
items.question_vi: Vì sao bạn thích vài cửa hàng nhỏ?
items.answer: I like them because staff can give personal advice. For example, a bookseller may recommend a suitable novel.
items.explanation_en: One reason and one realistic example build depth.
items.explanation_vi: Một lý do rõ và ví dụ thật tạo câu trả lời đầy đặn.

items.question_en: What do you dislike about busy malls?
items.question_vi: Bạn không thích gì ở mall đông?
items.answer: I dislike the noise, especially at weekends when the food court is crowded.
items.explanation_en: The explanation supports the feeling.
items.explanation_vi: Chi tiết cuối tuần đông làm rõ lý do.

items.question_en: Do you think you will shop differently in the future?
items.question_vi: Tương lai bạn mua khác đi không?
items.answer: I will probably buy more basics online, but I will still visit markets for fresh food.
items.explanation_en: A balanced prediction addresses the question and uses future language.
items.explanation_vi: Dự đoán cân bằng và dùng đúng will.

activities.title: Choose a note-taking structure
activities.instruction_en: Prepare a mind map or bullet-point plan for shopping.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghi chú sơ đồ ý hoặc gạch đầu dòng.

items.question_en: WHERE: note a location, not a full paragraph.
items.question_vi: Ghi nơi, không viết cả đoạn.
items.answer: near my school; next to a bus stop
items.explanation_en: Keywords are easier to scan during the one-minute planning period.
items.explanation_vi: Từ khóa ngắn dễ nhìn lại khi nói.

items.question_en: WHAT: list products available.
items.question_vi: Liệt kê đồ bán.
items.explanation_en: Concrete nouns prompt details.
items.explanation_vi: Danh từ cụ thể giúp triển khai.

items.question_en: WHY: give two reasons.
items.question_vi: Nêu hai lý do thích.
items.explanation_en: Two reasons provide enough ideas for a longer talk.
items.explanation_vi: Hai lý do hỗ trợ bài nói dài.

activities.title: Practise giving notes to a partner
activities.instruction_en: Turn brief notes into natural sentences.
activities.instruction_vi: Chuyển ghi chú thành câu nói.

items.question_en: Note: near campus / quiet / books. Say one natural sentence.
items.question_vi: Ghi chú gần trường/yên tĩnh/sách; nói câu.
items.answer: There is a quiet bookshop near my campus that sells both textbooks and novels.
items.explanation_en: Use a relative clause to connect details naturally.
items.explanation_vi: Mệnh đề that nối thông tin mà không liệt kê rời.

items.question_en: Note: visit twice monthly / helpful staff.
items.question_vi: Ghi chú hai lần/tháng, nhân viên tốt.
items.answer: I go there about twice a month because the staff are helpful.
items.explanation_en: Frequency + reason extends the response.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu tần suất kết hợp because.

activities.title: Speaking Part 2: understand the cue card
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track G and identify the four cue points.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe G, xác định bốn ý của cue card.

items.question_en: Which type of shop is described?
items.question_vi: Loại cửa hàng được mô tả?
items.explanation_en: The opening names a small stationery shop.
items.explanation_vi: Đầu Track G nói stationery shop.

items.question_en: Where is it?
items.question_vi: Nó ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: The speaker says close to the university, near a bus stop.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nêu gần trường đại học, trạm xe buýt.

items.question_en: How often does the person visit?
items.question_vi: Tần suất ghé?
items.explanation_en: The speaker gives this exact frequency.
items.explanation_vi: Track G nêu once or twice a month.

items.question_en: Why does the person like it?
items.question_vi: Vì sao thích?
items.explanation_en: The owner is helpful and products original; these support preference.
items.explanation_vi: Không khí thân thiện và giá hợp lý là hai lý do.

activities.title: Check one-minute Part 2 notes
activities.instruction_en: Evaluate keyword notes for a 2-minute talk.
activities.instruction_vi: Đánh giá ghi chú 1 phút.

items.question_en: Which notes are better? A. a complete memorised script B. location / products / visit / reasons
items.question_vi: Ghi chú nào tốt hơn?
items.explanation_en: Short cues support spontaneous speech.
items.explanation_vi: Ý ngắn giúp nói tự nhiên và dễ nhìn.

items.question_en: What should notes cover? A. all cue points B. only the shop name C. a random story
items.question_vi: Ghi chú cần bao phủ gì?
items.explanation_en: Each cue-card instruction should be addressed.
items.explanation_vi: Cần trả lời đủ ý cue card.

items.question_en: Name one way to expand notes.
items.question_vi: Một cách triển khai từ ghi chú.
items.answer: Add a short personal example of a purchase.
items.explanation_en: An example can add time and specificity.
items.explanation_vi: Một lần mua hàng cụ thể giúp kể sâu.

activities.title: Talk about buying a useful gift
activities.instruction_en: Build 30–45 second response from notes.
activities.instruction_vi: Nói 30–45 giây từ ghi chú.

items.question_en: What did you buy and for whom?
items.question_vi: Bạn mua gì cho ai?
items.answer: I bought a notebook for my younger cousin before the new school year.
items.explanation_en: A concrete item and recipient establish the story.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu món và người nhận để mở chuyện.

items.question_en: Why was it useful?
items.question_vi: Vì sao hữu ích?
items.answer: She could use it to organise homework and track her study goals.
items.explanation_en: Explain the value rather than repeating “useful”.
items.explanation_vi: Giải thích chức năng chứ không lặp useful.

items.question_en: How did the person react?
items.question_vi: Người nhận phản ứng sao?
items.answer: She smiled and said the gift was exactly what she needed.
items.explanation_en: A reaction gives the story an ending.
items.explanation_vi: Phản ứng tạo phần kết câu chuyện.

activities.title: Pronunciation and intonation
activities.instruction_en: Mark how positive/negative feelings sound.
activities.instruction_vi: Nhận diện ngữ điệu thể hiện cảm xúc.

items.question_en: “That’s fantastic!” often has ... intonation? A. expressive B. flat C. whispered
items.question_vi: Fantastic thường có giọng nào?
items.explanation_en: Enthusiasm is often shown with stronger stress and varied pitch.
items.explanation_vi: Cảm xúc hào hứng thể hiện qua nhấn và cao độ thay đổi.

items.question_en: “What a shame.” expresses ... A. disappointment B. excitement C. surprise at good news
items.question_vi: What a shame thể hiện gì?
items.explanation_en: The phrase usually expresses regret or disappointment.
items.explanation_vi: Cụm này chỉ tiếc nuối/thất vọng.

items.question_en: Practise two versions of “I love this shop” with different emphasis.
items.question_vi: Tự luyện hai cách nhấn I love this shop.
items.answer: Strong stress on LOVE conveys enthusiasm; neutral stress sounds matter-of-fact.
items.explanation_en: Stress changes emotional meaning without changing words.
items.explanation_vi: Nhấn LOVE tạo cảm giác rất thích; đọc đều mang sắc thái bình thường.

activities.title: Express three positive and negative opinions
activities.instruction_en: Write short comments and say them aloud.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết và nói 3 ý thích/không thích.

items.question_en: Give a positive comment about a market.
items.question_vi: Nêu ý tích cực về chợ.
items.answer: The atmosphere is lively, and the food is usually fresh.
items.explanation_en: Two details create a specific positive judgement.
items.explanation_vi: Không khí sôi động và đồ tươi là hai bằng chứng.

items.question_en: Give a negative comment about an online store.
items.question_vi: Nêu ý tiêu cực về cửa hàng online.
items.answer: Delivery can be slow, and returning items is sometimes inconvenient.
items.explanation_en: Specific drawbacks support the judgement.
items.explanation_vi: Chậm giao và khó hoàn trả là lý do cụ thể.

items.question_en: Give a mixed opinion about a large mall.
items.question_vi: Nêu đánh giá hai mặt về trung tâm thương mại.
items.answer: It has plenty of choices, although the crowds can be exhausting.
items.explanation_en: Although contrasts the benefit with the drawback.
items.explanation_vi: Although nối ưu điểm với bất lợi tự nhiên.

activities.title: Final Part 2 simulation
activities.instruction_en: Prepare for one minute, speak for up to two minutes about a shop you enjoy.
activities.instruction_vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút, nói tối đa 2 phút về cửa hàng yêu thích.

items.question_en: OPEN: introduce the shop and where it is.
items.question_vi: Mở: tên/loại cửa hàng và vị trí.
items.answer: I would like to describe a small bookshop near my home.
items.explanation_en: Begin directly with the subject.
items.explanation_vi: Mở trực tiếp theo cue card.

items.question_en: BODY: products, visits and one memory.
items.question_vi: Thân: đồ bán, tần suất và một kỷ niệm.
items.answer: It sells books and cards; I visit monthly and once found a rare travel guide there.
items.explanation_en: Add several connected details rather than a memorised list.
items.explanation_vi: Kết nối các chi tiết thành chuyện tự nhiên.

items.question_en: END: explain why you enjoy it.
items.question_vi: Kết: vì sao thích.
items.answer: I enjoy it because it is peaceful and the staff are welcoming.
items.explanation_en: End with a clear personal reason.
items.explanation_vi: Chốt bằng lý do cá nhân rõ ràng.

writing_models.title: Model A: Shopping centres and entertainment (Task 2, 250+ words)
writing_models.text:
Shopping centres have traditionally been places where people buy products, but many now offer entertainment and community services. I partly agree that leisure will become more important in these centres; however, I do not think shopping will disappear.

On the one hand, leisure activities give customers a reason to visit a centre even when they do not need to purchase anything. Cinemas, restaurants and indoor sports facilities can attract families and groups of friends. For example, parents may take their children to a climbing wall and then have lunch nearby. This creates a social experience that a website cannot fully provide. Moreover, shopping centres could become valuable public spaces if they include study rooms, local exhibitions or community events.

On the other hand, traditional retail will continue to serve important needs. Customers often want to try on shoes, check the quality of a product or ask a shop assistant for advice. Food shops and pharmacies also provide everyday goods, and many people find it practical to buy several items in one location. Although online retailers are convenient, deliveries can be delayed, and returning unsuitable products can take time. As a result, physical shops are likely to remain useful.

In conclusion, I believe entertainment and community facilities will take up a greater share of shopping centres in the future. Nevertheless, retail and leisure are more likely to develop together than to replace each other. The most successful centres will probably offer both convenient shopping and enjoyable places to spend time. This balance would benefit both customers and local businesses.
writing_models.vi: Bố cục 4 đoạn: mở bài paraphrase đề và nêu đồng ý một phần; đoạn 2 giải trí và dịch vụ cộng đồng với ví dụ; đoạn 3 bán lẻ vẫn thiết yếu và có so sánh mua online; kết luận nhắc lại quan điểm. Các từ however, moreover, although, as a result nối ý logic. Không học thuộc máy móc.

writing_models.title: Model B: Cashless society – advantages vs disadvantages (Task 2, 250+ words)
writing_models.text:
Paying without cash is becoming increasingly common in shops, cafés and public transport. Although digital payments have several disadvantages, I believe their benefits generally outweigh the drawbacks when cash remains available as an alternative.

One major advantage is convenience. People can pay quickly with a card or mobile phone without carrying large amounts of money. Digital records also help some customers review their spending and identify unnecessary purchases. For instance, a person who checks a monthly statement may notice that small daily purchases are adding up. In addition, cashless transactions can make online shopping easier because customers can complete an order without visiting a bank or an ATM.

However, there are important concerns. Not everyone owns a smartphone or has reliable internet access. Older people and residents in remote areas may find some payment systems confusing or unsuitable. Technical problems can also prevent customers from paying at a particular moment. Another concern is privacy: people may worry about how information about their transactions is stored or used. These issues show why access and security must be taken seriously.

In my view, the best solution is not to remove cash immediately but to offer several methods of payment. Businesses should protect customers' information and provide simple instructions for people who are unfamiliar with digital tools. Governments and banks also need to keep essential services accessible to people who cannot use applications.

Overall, cashless payments save time and provide useful records, so I believe the advantages are greater than the disadvantages. Nevertheless, the transition should be gradual and inclusive, with cash still accepted where it is needed.
writing_models.vi: Bài mở bằng bối cảnh và khẳng định ưu điểm nhìn chung lớn hơn nhược điểm nếu vẫn duy trì tiền mặt. Thân bài 1 phát triển tiện lợi, lịch sử giao dịch; thân bài 2 rủi ro tiếp cận, sự cố và quyền riêng tư. Đoạn 4 nêu giải pháp cân bằng trước khi kết luận. Bài mẫu không phải chấm band chính thức.
